seoTitle: Gym Services & Class Timetable | Ironclad, Baner Pune
seoDescription: Strength floor, Metcon 45 conditioning, personal coaching, yoga and mobility, body composition clinic and corporate batches in Baner, Pune. Full class timetable.
intro: Everything here is included in a full membership except personal coaching and the nutrition clinic, which are booked separately.

services.title: Power Up
services.body: Six platforms, four competition racks, calibrated plates to 250 kg, a full dumbbell run and cable stations. A coach is on the floor every hour we're open — ask any of them to watch a set.

services.title: Metcon 45
services.body: Mixed-modal conditioning — barbell, bike, rower, carries — capped at twelve so the coach sees every rep. Three scaling levels go on the board before you walk in.
services.bestFor: fat loss · work capacity · sport off-season

services.title: Personal Coaching
services.body: One coach, one plan, twelve weeks at a time. Starts with a movement screen and a goal conversation, ends with a written review of what your numbers did. Shift workers and frequent travellers welcome.

services.title: Be Flexible
services.body: Morning vinyasa, evening restorative, and a 75-minute mobility hour every Sunday that pairs with whatever you lifted that week. Mats, blocks and straps provided.

services.title: Body Comp Clinic
services.body: Measurements, weight trend and a plan review with a registered dietitian, built around home-cooked meals rather than a supplement list. Vegetarian, Jain and eggetarian plans are standard, not special requests.

services.title: Corporate & Sport
services.body: Early-morning batches for offices in the Baner–Balewadi belt, and off-season strength blocks for local cricket, football and badminton clubs. Includes a team screen and a monthly report for the coach or HR lead.
services.bestFor: office groups · club teams · school squads

timetableIntro: Open-floor training runs all day; the times below are coached classes. Sunday is mobility and open gym only.
plansIntro: We don't sell online and we don't lock anyone into a year. Ask at the desk or send an enquiry for current rates — they're the same either way.

plans.title: Day Pass
plans.body: Full floor and any class running that day. The first one is free.

plans.title: Monthly
plans.body: Everything included, rolling month to month. Pause up to 30 days a year at no cost.

plans.title: Quarterly / Annual
plans.body: The same access at a lower monthly rate, with a quarterly review and body-comp check built in.
